summary: Add a whiteboard block with notes, shapes, arrows, frames and pen lines

entries.summary: Add `BoardKit`, a whiteboard block with notes, geo shapes, arrows, frames and pen lines. Add it beside `EditorKit`. Its toolbar shows an icon for the select, note, arrow, frame and pen tools, a shape menu of rectangle, ellipse, diamond and triangle, a fill menu of colors and a button that fits every shape in view. Picking a color fills the selected notes and geo shapes. With none selected, it fills the next note or geo shape you add. The copied board writes every word the board says in `boardMessages`, and the board tells screen readers the selected shape and its place, the picked tool, the zoom and how many shapes a removal took off. The board is one Tab stop. When it takes focus, screen readers read the keys in `boardMessages.instructions`, and the copied board draws a focus ring while no shape is selected. Command with an arrow on a Mac, or Control with an arrow elsewhere, selects the nearest shape in that direction. `=`, `+` and `-` zoom by steps, Shift+0 resets the zoom, Shift+1 fits every shape, and PageUp and PageDown pan, sideways with Shift. Shift+Enter moves focus from the board to its toolbar, and Escape moves it back. A Yjs room created before the board refuses an editor with it, so seed a new room from the old room's document, as the Board docs page shows.

Add `BoardPageKit`, whose `BoardPageElement` draws a board that fills its container, for a page whose one block is a board. The `board-page-demo` example builds that page without `EditorKit`, whose drag handles and trailing paragraph would wrap and follow the board.
